name: Bank of Kyoto
verdict: The Bank of Kyoto is a group company of Kyoto Financial Group, TSE-listed; its largest holders are trust banks and insurers. Nothing found.
note: Front (right collarbone) sponsor of Kyoto Sanga 2026-27 per the club's uniform sponsors announcement, 2026-06-15. Rating note: the bank moved under listed holding company Kyoto Financial Group in October 2023; KFG's largest holder is Master Trust at 12.37%, with no state holder of 5% or more (kyoto-financial-group-shareholders). No human-rights finding against the bank was found in a quick check (2026-10-01).
